topic: Impact of AI on creative industries

music.title: IFPI Global Music Report 2026
music.excerpt: 62% of surveyed labels used generative tools in production during 2025.

music.title: Musicians' Union member survey
music.excerpt: 48% of members reported using AI tools in composition or mixing.

writing.title: Authors Guild AI survey
writing.excerpt: Median reported income effect of AI on freelance writers: -11% year over year.

film.title: Visual Effects Society workforce note
film.excerpt: Previsualisation time fell by roughly 30% on productions using AI storyboarding.

documents.name: WIPO-Creative-Economy-2025.pdf
documents.excerpt: Generative AI adoption among creative SMEs reached 41% in 2025, up from 23% in 2023.

documents.name: UNESCO-Culture-Report-2026.pdf
documents.excerpt: Adoption among creative SMEs is estimated at 55% in 2025; methodology weights by firm size.
